name: opencode-docs
body:
The opencode 2.x dependency documentation: `README.md`'s dependency line, `apg init` section, and querying-from-opencode section, and `AGENTS.md`'s CLI section. Both name opencode 2.x and the `@opencode/plugin` dependency and state the plugin install location under `~/.opencode/` (`plugins/`) alongside the shared lib and the seven distributed agents, keeping the restart-opencode-after-init note.

A NARROW owner distinct from `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` (the roster count and the push/tag user-doc half) and `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (the frontend dependency contract): this component owns the opencode-2.x-dependency statement alone.

implemented-by: `README.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
